# GoldPan AI Context Firewall
## Layer 1: Structural & Steganographic Sanitization
GoldPan defends LLM agents against indirect prompt injection by stripping invisible DOM nodes (`display:none`, `opacity:0`), PDF zero-point characters, DOCX vanished runs (`w:vanish`), and Unicode Tag steganography (`U+E0000`–`U+E007F`) before retrieval indexing.

# Hybrid Retrieval Architecture
## Reciprocal Rank Fusion with SQLite FTS5 & E5 ONNX
GoldPan combines dense vector similarity from `intfloat/multilingual-e5-small` (384-d) with persistent lexical BM25 ranking in SQLite FTS5 (`goldpan_fts.db`) using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60) and Vietnamese diacritic folding.

# Hardware-Aware ONNX Acceleration
## Tier 2: Windows DirectML (AMD Radeon RX 6600 & RX 5000)
On Windows systems with DirectX 12 GPUs, GoldPan routes `intfloat/multilingual-e5-small` through `DmlExecutionProvider` with bounded `batch_size=12` and automatic fallback to `CPUExecutionProvider` INT8 if warmup fails.
